name: Kestrel Nine
description: A dead salvage station in a slow tumble: a dock ring, a spine corridor, a workshop, and a hold nobody has finished clearing.

dock_ring.name: Dock Ring
dock_ring.description: The outer ring, open to a hard black sky. Clamp marks scar the deck where ships used to sit; a spine corridor runs north, and the workshop hatch is east.

spine_corridor.name: Spine Corridor
spine_corridor.description: A ribbed corridor down the station's spine. Half the strip lights are dead, and the hold door at the far end stands open.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: Benches, jigs and a fabrication bay with its cover half off. Someone left mid-job and never came back.

hold.name: Cargo Hold
hold.description: Empty racks and a drifting haze of frost. Something in here has been moving since the lights went out.
